summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Chapelfield Grove, Norwich, with a 1.8 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294G INSTALLED WI 1.8NM RADIUS OF PSN
523742N 0011727E (CHAPELFIELD GROVE, NORWICH). BEYOND VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT
400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE 
WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL 
LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED.
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR 
INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-8222/03.
